explanation: Encodes the Pach–Tóth upper bound g(n) ≤ (5/16)n as: for every ε > 0, g(n) ≤ (5/16+ε)n for infinitely many n. As the docstring notes, the literal bound fails for small n (g(1) = 1), so some weakening is needed. This one is faithful in spirit and, given that the limit of g(n)/n exists by subadditivity, equivalent to lim g(n)/n ≤ 5/16.
